messages:
maya: Heads-up — final preflight for staggered canary in ~3h. Quiet window 10:00-12:00 PDT. Posting checklist, reply with :+1: if good.
jordan: I'll pin model v2.3.1 to canary and keep v2.2.9 as fallback. @deploy-bot please schedule the rollout.
deploy-bot: @jordan received. Pin applied to canary variant: `model:v2.3.1-canary`.
kevin: Rollback criteria proposed: if 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m OR P50 latency +40ms vs baseline, trigger rollback to v2.2.9. any objections?
sabrina: No objections. DB migration deferred — no schema changes this rollout.
maya: Quick checklist (T-30m I'll run smoke):
- confirm traffic split config
- canary health checks in place
- logs + traces enabled (sampling=100% for canary)
- alerting: pageset 'inference-canary' wired to #eng-oncall
- preflight smoke on staging + golden prompts run
oncall-ash: Added pageset 'inference-canary' and set slack alerts to #eng-oncall. Pager thresholds: 5xx >= 0.5% for 3m -> P2.
jordan: Deploy plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% over 15m; canary steady-state 30m after 50%. Command I'll run:
```
deploy-bot rollout --target canary-pool --model v2.3.1 --steps 10,25,50 --interval 5m
```
deploy-bot: rollout queued. Starting first step in 2m.
kevin: We'll enable KV prefix cache warmup (avoid cold-cache latency spikes).
sabrina: Confirmed infra: CPU/GPU quotas OK, no infra changes.
maya: If canary passes, plan to expand to dedicated at 80% in next change window. If fails, rollback plan:
```
1) deploy-bot rollback --to v2.2.9
2) notify #eng-oncall and product
3) open incident if >30m degraded
```
jordan: :+1: I'll stay around for the whole window; tagging @deploy-bot and @oncall-ash for visibility.
deploy-bot: step 1 started: 10% traffic -> canary-pool. Instances: 5. started_at 2067895621.
maya: Thanks — I'll watch dashboards (latency / cost / quality) and post updates.
